policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: Apple has released HomeView, its first smart home display featuring a 7-inch touchscreen and built-in Siri AI, priced at $299.
Google is making it easier for users to launch personal, AI-generated "vibe-coded" apps directly through the Play Store, removing the need for phone-to-computer connections.
Gemini 4 Argon, a new Google AI model, has begun rolling out in the Gemini app and Antigravity, with discounted API rates available for developers through November.

world.summary: Vatican officials announced that Pope Leo's surgery to remove a lung lump was successfully concluded, after the growth was found at an early stage.
China has sentenced three individuals to death for operating scam centers in Myanmar, with dozens more imprisoned for various related crimes including fraud, trafficking, prostitution, and murder.

Tensions have escalated between the UK and Argentina over the Falkland Islands, with Argentina lodging a legal claim against the UK's oil exploration and Britain asking Interpol to reject Argentina's arrest requests.
The conflict between Saudi Arabia and Houthi forces in Yemen has intensified with Saudi strikes on strategic oil depots near Sana'a, as the WHO reported a surge in cholera cases in the country.

us.summary: Federal agents searched the Washington, D.C. home of Representative Ilhan Omar as part of an ongoing federal investigation.
Florida carried out an execution, which was the state's 17th this year, amid scrutiny following a botched lethal injection attempt in Tennessee.
Kimberly Guilfoyle resigned as US ambassador to Greece after the White House requested her departure, following reports of alleged misconduct.

science.summary: Clinicians are recommending reduced screen time in English schools to prevent long-term health issues, including a rise in short-sightedness among students.
Emergency room departments are reporting a significant increase in pediatric trauma accidents related to micromobility devices like e-bikes, prompting calls for federal regulation.
